notes: Ernitec's current IP camera range (Deimos, Wolf, Pluto, Orion Pro, Jupitor Pro, Saturn Pro, Halo Pro) uses the Web Operation Guide published by Ernitec for its Base/Pro IP cameras, which documents the RTSP rule rtsp://ip:port/snl/live/<cameraid>/<streamid> (example rtsp://192.168.99.14:554/snl/live/1/1) on the Configuration > Protocol > Protocol Info page; each camera also displays its own RTSP rule/example on that page. The guide is titled for the Base/Pro lines; the Ultra multi-sensor/thermal lines are not explicitly named, so confirm on the camera's Protocol Info page (a second sensor would use cameraid 2). Legacy SX-series (Hawk/Mercury/Orion SX) manuals publish no path; the unverified_leads below come only from crowd-sourced lists.
